findings.description: Internal final-attestation.json SHA does not match actual uploaded ZIP
findings.details: Internal attestation claims SHA 791e9d08... and size 155,530 bytes. Actual uploaded ZIP is SHA 92e73f93... and size 155,534 bytes. This is because the ZIP was re-frozen AFTER the attestation was embedded inside it (bootstrap paradox: writing the SHA of a file that changes when you write to it).
findings.root_cause: Evidence Authority Protocol v2 places final-attestation.json inside the ZIP before computing the final SHA, then re-freezes. The re-freeze changes the ZIP bytes, invalidating the embedded attestation.
findings.mitigation: External sidecar (.sha256) and external final-attestation.json DO match the actual ZIP. The external files are authoritative. Internal attestation is non-authoritative.
